reader_summary.overview: Nick is the CEO of The Rohatyn Group. Nick previously spent two decades leading JP Morgan's emerging markets business across multiple cycles and served on the bank's Executive Committee. He also served as the founding chair of the Emerging Market Traders Association and later as chair of the Emerging Markets Private Equity Association.

key_points.text: Nick is the CEO of The Rohatyn Group.
Nick's worldview is also shaped by his international family history of doing well while doing good.
His grandfather, Clarence Streit, was a longtime New York Times foreign correspondent, and his father, Felix Rohatyn.
